project_overview.name: TREXIO
project_overview.description: Marketplace platform for open trips / adventure booking focusing on Indonesian travelers.
project_overview.core_vibe: Modern adventure aesthetic, earthy tones, bold typography, imagery-heavy, paired with a clean minimal marketplace layout.

theme.archetype: Organic & Earthy + Swiss High-Contrast. The app uses bone-white and warm sand bases mixed with dark forest green and terracotta to convey adventure without losing marketplace clarity.

rules: H1 maximum text-5xl sm:text-6xl. No text-7xl+.
Overlines must be uppercase + tiny + tracking-[0.2em].

primary.description: Terracotta for action buttons and CTA

secondary.description: Deep Forest Green for accents and heavy structural blocks

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12, p-16) to create breathing room.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Use Mode A (Tetris Grid) for Homepage and Marketing sections. Use Mode B (Density Grid) for Admin and User Dashboards.
grids_and_layouts.containers: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Mobile-First. Left-align text for better readability. Optical alignment over geometrical.

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-md) for marketplace utility feel. Strict focus states. Solid primary for CTAs only.
components.navigation: Header must have visible nav links on desktop. Use Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) if scrolling under, solid if not. DO NOT use completely transparent background.
components.trip_card: Image heavily dominant. 1px border. Minimal text overlay to preserve image. Must be reusable across Homepage and Explore.
components.sticky_booking_panel: Must stick on scroll. Use Glassmorphism or solid white surface with drop-shadow-xl. Contains form and CTAs.
components.forms: Use Shadcn/UI for Selects, Datepickers, and forms. Multi-step booking must feel seamless with clear progress indicators. Include file upload input for manual payment confirmation.
components.status_timeline: Vertical step indicator for Payment Tracking. Clear visual distinction between past, current, and future states.
components.toasts: Use 'sonner' for payment tracking and booking notifications.

surfaces.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-[#E5E1D8]), no default shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
surfaces.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px delicate inner stroke border-white/40. No muddy transparency.
surfaces.dashboard: Solid flat panels with sharp edges, dense spacing. Avoid 'card' wrapper overload.

rules: Use specific transitions: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
Micro-animations on hover/click (e.g., scale button slightly down on active).

icons_and_assets.usage: Use Phospor Icons for that premium editorial and adventure feel.

accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px must be 4.5:1. Interactive elements 3:1.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid="booking-submit-button").

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute the design strictly matching the E1 Anti-AI Designer persona. Focus on trust, clarity, and speed.
Implement the UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components. Use .js and .jsx files (No TypeScript).
Inject the custom font imports into the CSS file.
For multi-step booking, ensure the sticky panel updates state dynamically.
Build the dashboard leveraging a dense grid for KPI cards, queues, and trip catalogs.
Never use via.placeholder.com. ONLY use the provided image URLs.
Use Bahasa Indonesia for all UI copy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific property transitions.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Rely on @phosphor-icons/react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Ensure padding inside bordered containers.
Always add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
Always add GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES
